title: Optimize Geometry for Rendering
summary: Official Derivative rendering-performance guide for geometry in Render TOPs, covering primitive type/count, vertex count, SOP count, VBO updates, batching, triangle strips, Vulkan conversion costs, Performance Monitor symptoms, and Merge SOP tradeoffs.
guidance: Use this article when a render plan has heavy SOP geometry or unexpected Render TOP performance cost.
For static geometry, prefer 3 vertex polygons or triangle strips; for geometry changing every frame from SOP cooking, prefer pre-converted triangle strips to avoid expensive CPU conversion.
Reducing batch count can matter more than reducing vertex count; each SOP creates at least one batch, and a Merge SOP can combine batchable geometry that shares material.
Avoid Merge SOP as a blanket fix when inputs cook every frame, because the merge cook may cost more than rendering extra batches.
Use Performance Monitor entries such as Updating SOP's VBO, Waiting For VBO Update, and Rendering a batches of VBOs to locate geometry upload or batch bottlenecks.
Treat GPU render cost from shaders, pixel fill rate, and lighting complexity as separate from the geometry-specification costs described here.
